summary: Deterministic Paxlet action resolution and Taskand integration

delivery.outcome: Verified action addressing and atomic content-addressed Paxlet storage with derived catalog records for Taskand; publish the tested branch and PR, obtain exact-head independent Validator review and protected-controller merge as authorized by the user.
nonGoals: Changes to Taskand or nl-dsl-sh repositories

architecture.decision: Registry-authorized aliases, digest-pinned local execution, atomic verified content objects and manifest-derived catalog projections; Taskand owns mutable node catalog and synchronization
interfaceChanges: Strict action references, verified resolution and content-store APIs with manifest-derived records
CLI invoke, version/digest pins and verified resolution

dataChanges.description: Private core package cache uses objects-v1 for new installations. Existing legacy cache/index files remain untouched; there is no data migration, shared catalog schema change or transfer of ownership. Archive transport remains paxlet-archive/0.1.
